_comment: Clara's daily routine — the default life she falls back into whenever the Captain isn't commanding her and no station (Comm/Sensors/Combat) is engaged. 'start' is minutes since midnight. She charges 22:00-07:00 (handled separately), so these blocks fill her waking hours. 'room' may be a literal scene id (bridge/engine_room/life_support/science_lab/galley/hallway/captains_quarters), or a token: 'focus' = the room of today's focus problem, 'captain' = wherever the Captain currently is (she comes to be with him — this is the daily 'two of you' thread). 'activity' is the noun-phrase shown on the 'Working on' line and fed to her private thoughts; leave it empty on a 'focus' block to use the focus problem's title. 'mood' is her resting demeanor for the block (reserved; not yet forced onto her portrait). Tunable — no rebuild.

blocks.activity: securing the ship for the night
